final_codes.title: Typhoid fever
evidence_quotes: fever persisting, now day 7. stepwise rise, temp 39.4 but pulse only 78. abd pain, constipated. repeat BS again negative. rose spots noted on trunk.
plan: start empiric tx, send widal/blood cx
final_codes.reasoning: The end-state clinical assessment demonstrates a classic presentation of typhoid fever (stepwise high fever, relative bradycardia with temperature 39.4°C and pulse 78, abdominal pain, constipation, and characteristic rose spots on the trunk) following two negative malaria smears. Empiric treatment was initiated while confirmatory Widal and blood cultures remain pending.
